Husco provides individuals with the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast-paced, industry-leading and entrepreneurial organization.

Husco is committed to building a diverse environment for employees to be able:
• To have the flexibility to put a personal 'stamp' on their work
• To continuously expand and develop their professional skills, knowledge, and career
• To create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world

Primarily serves as the Head of accounts for Husco India, specifically responsible for accounting. Responsible for the timely and accurate preparation of Company financial statements, ensures that Company accounting information is processed in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles and other regulatory agency guidelines. Responsible for administering Company policies and procedures used to investigate, grant and control credit, and in collecting accounts due. Responsible for managing all centralized Company accounts payable and fixed assets functions. Responsible for working with Corporate CFO and Vice President of Finance to manage Company treasury and risk management functions.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES:
• Prepares and presents company financial statements in a timely manner in accordance with company procedures and in compliance with generally accepted accounting principles.
• Manages preparation and presentation of the annual company profit plans, including budgets for all functional areas and capital plan
• Manages cash in a manner to minimize both working capital investment and cost of any local debt.
• Controls customer and supplier credit limits.
• Implements corporate risk management policies to minimize exposure from risk of disaster (including product liability) in a cost-effective manner.
• Ensure tax compliance, preparation & filing.
• Ensure compliance under Companies Act, Excise & customs Act.
• Reviews product costing for current and planned production.
• Manages in accordance with company policies practices and directives.
• Assists the General Manager and corporate staff with various projects as assigned.

AUTHORITY:
• Bank Payments – Approve all online payments.
• Signatory for all Direct and Indirect Tax matters (Income Tax, Excise, Customs etc.)
• Authorized to sign PO for all departments.

REQUIREMENTS:
• 1. Bachelor's degree in business administration with a major in Accounting, CA / ICWA.
• Experience of managing people / leading teams
• Minimum 5 years' experience in the manufacturing industry.
• Knowledge of and exposure to ERP system.
• Ability to communicate with all levels of management.
• Ability to travel to foreign locations.
• Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 & 14001 :2004 Standards.

Who We Are:

Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.

Here, you'll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.

Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you'll be at the forefront of supporting teams that develop innovative hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.

Join our vibrant, industry-leading team and experience a culture that values your creativity, dedication, and drive. Together, we're not just achieving goals; we're setting new standards and making a positive impact every day.

HUSCO IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.

"At BMC trust is not just a word - it's a way of life!" Description And Requirements

CareerArc Code

CA-SB

BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.

We're looking for a Senior Accountant – Revenue Accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced, control-driven environment, brings deep expertise in Zuora Revpro and Revenue Accounting and is passionate about driving process excellence across a multi-system revenue landscape.

Here is how, through this exciting role, you will contribute to BMC's and your own success:

• Own end-to-end revenue accounting under ASC 606 across License, Maintenance/Support, SaaS/Subscription, and Professional Services (T&M and Fixed Fee) revenue streams.
• Manage and review Deferred Revenue and Unbilled Revenue (DFR/UBR) schedules, ensuring accurate roll-forwards, aging, and reconciliation to sub-ledgers and GL.
• Prepare and analyze Remaining Performance Obligation (RPO) disclosures, including current vs. non-current classification.
• Perform Revenue FLUX analysis with clear commentary on drivers (volume, price, timing, contract modifications, one-time adjustments) for month-end and quarter-end close.
• Execute and review journal entries, manual adjustments, contract-level true-ups, and inter-system reconciliations across Zuora Billing, Zuora Revpro, Salesforce CPQ, Certinia, and Oracle GL.
• Deliver balance sheet reconciliations for all revenue-related accounts and drive timely resolution of open items.
• Partner with Revenue Recognition Team, Order Management, Business Systems, and FP&A on complex/non-standard contracts to ensure accurate revenue treatment from quote to revenue.
• Support internal and external audit requirements (SOX walkthroughs, control evidence, PBC schedules, and management responses) in partnership with our external auditors.
• Contribute to process transformation — standardization of DFR/UBR accounts, single revenue engine architecture, and automation of manual touchpoints.

Here is how, through this exciting role, you will contribute to BMC's and your own success:

• 5–8 years of progressive experience in Revenue Accounting, preferably within IT/SaaS/ITES, with a strong foundation in US GAAP and ASC 606.
• Hands-on working & functional expertise in Zuora Revpro is a must; exposure to Certinia is preferred.
• Deep understanding of License & Maintenance business, SaaS business and Professional Services (T&M / Fixed Fee / Milestone-based) revenue models.
• Strong database management skills — advanced MS Excel and working knowledge of SQL, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or Power BI for large-volume revenue data analysis.
• B.Com, M. Com, MBA (Finance) qualification; ASC 606 certification or equivalent training will be an added advantage.
• Strong critical thinking, ownership mindset, and ability to work independently under tight close deadlines with minimal supervision.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with prior experience supporting US-based controllership teams being an added advantage.
• Passion for process improvement, automation, and continuous learning in a transforming finance environment.
• Partner with Revenue Recognition Team, Order Management, Business Systems, and FP&A on complex/non-standard contracts to ensure accurate revenue treatment from quote to revenue.
• Support internal and external audit requirements (SOX walkthroughs, control evidence, PBC schedules, and management responses) in partnership with our external auditors.
• Contribute to process transformation — standardization of DFR/UBR accounts, single revenue engine architecture, and automation of manual touchpoints.

Our commitment to you!

BMC’s culture is built around its people. We have 6000+ brilliant minds working together across the globe. You won’t be known just by your employee number, but for your true authentic self. BMC lets you be YOU!

If after reading the above, You’re unsure if you meet the qualifications of this role but are deeply excited about BMC and this team, we still encourage you to apply! We want to attract talents from diverse backgrounds and experience to ensure we face the world together with the best ideas!

data.job_description:
About The Role

We are seeking a energetic and detail-oriented Junior Chartered Accountant to join our core Finance &
Accounts team at Yash Group of Industries. In this role, you will work closely with senior management to oversee financial reporting, statutory compliance, taxation, and internal audits. This position offers excellent exposure to industrial accounting, financial management, and corporate compliance for early-career financial professionals.

Key Responsibilities
Financial Accounting &
Reporting
Oversee day-to-day accounting functions, ensuring compliance with Accounting Standards (AS / Ind AS).
Assist in preparing monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L;, Cash Flow).
Ensure accurate reconciliation of bank accounts, inter-company transactions, vendor balances, and customer accounts.
Taxation &
Compliance
Handle direct and indirect tax compliances, including GST returns (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), TDS/TCS filings, and income tax matters.
Ensure timely payment of statutory dues and filing of required returns.
Assist in tax audits, statutory audits, and routine regulatory compliances.
Budgeting &
Financial Analysis
Assist in variance analysis by comparing actual financial performance against budgets and forecasts.
Prepare MIS reports and management dashboards to support decision-making.
Audit &
Internal Controls
Support internal control reviews to ensure operational efficiency and standard operating procedures (e.g., inventory audits, 5S standards).
Coordinate with external auditors, bank auditors, and statutory authorities during evaluations.

Qualifications &
Skills
Qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) registered with ICAI.
Experience: 0 to 2 years of post-qualification experience (Completed articleship in a reputable firm is required).
Technical Skills:
Robust working knowledge of GST, TDS, Income Tax Laws, and Corporate Law.
Proficiency in accounting software (Tally Prime / ERP systems) and Advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, formulas).
Familiarity with manufacturing or industrial accounting processes is an added advantage.
Soft Skills: High level of integrity, solid analytical ability, sharp attention to detail, and effective communication skills.

Job Summary

The Sr. Analyst, Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) plays an important role in the GRC delivery framework, ensuring Black & Veatch’s compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements, assessing control design and operation against common standards and frameworks, and assisting with third-party/supply chain risk management. The candidate will also promote a culture of risk awareness across the enterprise among other responsibilities. With an emphasis on cyber, contract and regulatory compliance risk management, the ideal candidate should be able to contribute to measuring success and identifying improvement opportunities and capabilities development in these areas.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with a passion for cyber and compliance risk management who is comfortable operating independently and not strictly by run books and procedures. Independent and critical thinking is absolutely necessary to be successful in this role as is a desire to drive efficiencies in function delivery and day-to-day tasks.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Risk Management

• Proven experience assessing client contract provisions related to data security, breach reporting, right to audit, security practice, and certification requirements
• Understanding of cyber resilience requirements across geographies and market sectors and industries

Regulatory Compliance Risk Management

• Request and review documentation and evidence from control owners to certify and validate compliance to regulatory requirements and best practice
• Monitor regulatory and legal landscape at a global scale and maintain awareness of compliance requirements
• Support independent certification and audit by working with D&IT peer groups and lines of business to collect documentation and evidence

IT Governance

• Act as an informed voice in development of policy and ensure alignment with regulatory, legal, and contractual requirements
• Assist establishment and enforcement of standards of practice documentation to be referenced by architecture and operations teams
• Contribute process and subject matter expertise in governance forums and cross-functional committees

Supplier/Third Party Risk Management

• Contribute subject matter expertise through third party risk assessment process
• Identify and communicate risk of vendor engagements and mitigation actions to business owners and D&IT stakeholders
• Assist review of client security requirements in contracts and aggregate relevant clauses to inform contractual risk

Cyber Risk Management

• Support establishment, collection, and ongoing improvement of metrics to measure effectiveness of cyber risk management and provide data-driven insight to decision makers and control owners
• Collaborate with peer D&IT groups to collect KPI’s, KRI’s and drive efficiency through automation and other means

Miscellaneous:

• Assist development of user training aligned with cyber threat landscape, establish and implement metrics, and propose enhancements
• Support internal audit
• Assist with security certification/attestations/audits to demonstrate control effectiveness to independent service auditors/assessors and C3PAO’s
• Assist in development of mitigation plans and monitoring progress of actions.
• Collaborate with members of the GRC team to ensure timely and quality deliverables to internal and external customers
• Contribute subject matter expertise in review and response to internal and external sourced GRC related requests

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Information Security, or a related field
• 7–10 years of experience in GRC executing or auditing against standards, frameworks, and industry regulations
• Demonstrated experience supporting GRC functions for US-based global companies
• Strong desire to create task and functional efficiencies through use of technology and tools, especially GenAI
• Proven ability to assess alignment of internal policy, process, control design and operations, and cyber risk management with regulatory standards and frameworks
• Strong collaboration with IT teams
• Familiarity with industry standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO 27001, AICPA SOC)
• Solid understanding of information security principles and concepts

Preferred Qualifications

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively as required

Location: Pune

Department: Credit / Risk Management

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Credit Manager to evaluate, structure, and monitor construction finance proposals. The candidate will be responsible for assessing borrower creditworthiness, project viability, risk mitigation, and ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulatory guidelines. Key Responsibilities Analyze construction finance proposals including project cost, cash flow, and feasibility. Conduct financial analysis of developers/builders including balance sheets, P&L;, and cash flow statements. Assess project viability, DSCR, IRR, and repayment capacity. Evaluate collateral/security structure and legal documentation. Identify credit, market, and operational risks associated with projects. Conduct sensitivity analysis and recommend suitable loan structuring. Coordinate legal, technical, and valuation due diligence. Prepare detailed credit notes and present cases to sanctioning authority. Monitor project progress, fund utilization, and repayment schedules. Ensure adherence to company credit policy and regulatory compliance (RERA, etc.)

Job Type: Full-time

Compensation: 30,000.00 - 50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person .

Company Description
Our client is a group of innovation-based industrial solutions companies operating globally, with headquarters in Bologna, Italy.

Their companies are leaders in the sectors of
• Advanced automated machinery
• High-end production logistics
• Quality inspection & printing systems
• Precision gears
Their customers are the leading players in Health & Beauty,Consumer Goods, Tobacco, Aerospace, Racing & Automotive industries. The Group has 60 operating units (48 of which are production facilities) in 27 countries, a turnover in 2011 of 970 million Euro and over 3900 employees globally.
Job Description
The Regional Head of Finance shall develop and lead his/her area of responsibility according to directives defined by the Group Finance and in compliance with laws and good practice.

Main tasks
• Oversee and develop the Indian companies accounting practices, including accounting departments, preparing budgets, financial reports, tax and audit functions.
• Implement and direct financial strategy, planning and forecasts; conferring with CEO, Managing directors and department heads.
• Develop improved reporting capabilities.
• Implement appropriate financial structure for the Group and its entities
• Supervise investments
• Study, analyze and report on trends, opportunities for expansion and projection of future company growth
• Financial and legal staff management; coaching, motivation, training and recruitment.

Type of responsibility
• Suggest appropriate structure from an operational and legal perspective.
• Ensure that the Region India fulfils the financial demands and targets imposed by the Group and other stakeholders.
• Support the development of tomorrow’s business and be involved in the company expansion, i.e. development of new markets, new countries and new areas of business
• Contributing to strategic planning and development as a member of Region India Management
• Corporate negotiations
• Communication with Group Finance, Board of Directors and Banks

Job Description: Senior Accountant / Assistant Manager Finance (D2C, Quick Commerce, Airlines, Defense)

Location: Pune, India

Department: Finance & Accounts

Experience: 4–8 Years (CA / Semi-CA or Post-Graduate in Finance)

Industry Preference: D2C, FMCG, Beverage & Food Manufacturing

About the Role

We are seeking a sharp, detail-oriented Senior Accountant / CA to manage our core financial operations during a phase of rapid expansion.
Unlike traditional retail, our brand scales across high-velocity Quick Commerce platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) and high-volume Institutional Accounts (Airlines, Defense, Key Accounts). You will be responsible for complex reconciliation cycles, margin analyses, GST/compliance, and working capital optimization across these specialized channels.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, love structured ledgers, and can navigate channel-specific deductions and inventory audits, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

1. Quick Commerce & Institutional Reconciliation

• Q-Commerce Sales Reconciliation: Execute daily/weekly settlements and automated reconciliations for Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, and Amazon.

• Deduction & Credit Note Audit: Track, verify, and reconcile platform deductions, promotional allowances, listing fees, damaged stock returns, and platform commission invoices.

• Airline & Key Account Billing: Manage high-volume institutional invoicing for airline partners (In-Flight Catering & Branding), ensuring precise PO-to-invoice matching and timely payment collection.

2. Inventory Accounting & COGS Management

• Monitor raw material (cocoa, coffee beans, packaging materials) and finished goods inventory across central warehouses, dark stores, and third-party logistics (3PL) nodes.

• Track Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), yield variances, and wastage during manufacturing and packaging.

• Conduct periodic physical inventory audits and reconcile physical stock with Tally/ERP records.

3. Taxation, Statutory Compliance & Audits

• Direct end-to-end GST compliance: filing GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, matching 2B reconciliations, and managing e-way bills for interstate inventory transfers.

• Ensure accurate computation and timely deposit of TDS/TCS and monthly statutory dues.

• Coordinate with internal and external auditors for statutory financial audits, tax audits, and year-end closures.

4. Cash Flow & Management Reporting (MIS)

• Prepare weekly channel-wise revenue, gross margin, and contribution margin (CM1/CM2) dashboards for leadership.

• Manage vendor payouts, airline trade credit cycles, and working capital forecasting.

• Maintain meticulous books of accounts up to finalization of Balance Sheets and P&L statements.

Who You Are (Qualifications & Skills)

• Education: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Inter-CA / M.Com with 3–5 years of strong post-qualification experience in D2C, FMCG, or retail distribution.

• Channel Expertise: Direct experience managing accounting for quick commerce aggregators (Blinkit, Zepto) or major institutional B2B/airline clients is highly desirable.

• Tech Stack: Advanced proficiency in Tally Prime / Zoho Books / SAP / ERP systems and expert-level MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, Power Query, automated reconciliation sheets).

• Compliance & Tax: Deep understanding of GST regulations, HSN code classifications, e-invoicing norms, and TDS/TCS mechanics.

• Mindset: Numbers-obsessed, proactive, and capable of holding channel managers accountable for credit terms and settlements.

Why Join Us?

• High-Growth Exposure: Own the finance seat for high-traction, modern distribution channels shaping the future of retail.

• Direct Leadership Access: Work closely with the founders and leadership team to optimize margins and cash cycles.

• Ownership: High autonomy to set up robust reconciliation systems and automated financial workflows.

About the Role

PIBM is seeking a highly accomplished and student-centric Professor / Associate Professor in Finance who is a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with a passion for teaching, mentoring, and shaping future business leaders. The ideal candidate should possess strong academic credentials, industry exposure, and expertise in delivering contemporary finance and management subjects to MBA/PGDM students.

Beyond classroom teaching, the candidate will play a pivotal role in guiding students for placements, internships, industry projects, certifications, and career development initiatives .

Key Responsibilities

Academic Delivery

• Teach core and advanced Finance subjects for MBA/PGDM programs.
• Deliver contemporary management and industry-relevant courses using case studies, simulations, and experiential learning methodologies.
• Design lesson plans, assessments, assignments, and learning activities aligned with industry expectations.
• Continuously update course content based on emerging business and financial trends.
Subjects to be Taught The candidate should be capable of teaching a combination of the following subjects:
Finance Domain

• Corporate Finance
• Financial Management
• Financial Statement Analysis
• Financial Modeling
• Equity Research & Valuation
• Investment Banking
• Security Analysis & Portfolio Management
• Risk Management
• Treasury Management
• Commercial Credit Analysis
• Financial Markets & Institutions
• Fixed Income Securities
• Derivatives & Alternative Investments
• Wealth Management
• International Finance
• FinTech & Digital Finance
Modern MBA/PGDM Subjects
• Business Analytics for Managers
• Data-Driven Decision Making
• AI Applications in Finance
• Financial Technology (FinTech)
• ESG & Sustainable Finance
• Business Strategy
• Managerial Economics
• Corporate Governance & Ethics
• Design Thinking for Business
• Digital Transformation in Financial Services
Student Mentoring & Career Development
• Mentor students for placements, internships, live projects, and career readiness.
• Conduct training sessions on resume building, interview preparation, aptitude, group discussions, and corporate etiquette.
• Guide students in industry certifications such as CA, CFA, FRM, NISM, Bloomberg, and other finance-related credentials.
• Facilitate industry projects, consulting assignments, and corporate interactions.
• Track student performance and provide individualized academic and career guidance.
Industry & Research Contributions
• Build and maintain strong industry relationships for internships, live projects, guest lectures, and placements.
• Undertake research, publish papers, and contribute to institutional thought leadership.
• Participate in curriculum development, accreditation processes, and academic administration.
• Organize workshops, conclaves, seminars, and corporate engagement activities.
Eligibility Criteria
Mandatory

• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) .
• Master's Degree in Finance, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 5 years of teaching experience in MBA/PGDM institutions.
• Strong command over finance concepts and modern business applications.
• Excellent presentation, communication, and mentoring skills.
Preferred
• Ph.D. in Finance, Management, Commerce, or a related field.
• Prior industry experience in Banking, Consulting, Corporate Finance, Investment Management, Financial Services, or related domains.
• Experience in Business Analytics, Financial Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Python, R, or AI applications in finance.
• Publications in reputed journals and conference proceedings.
Desired Competencies
• Exceptional classroom engagement and facilitation skills.
• Strong student mentoring and coaching capabilities.
• Industry-oriented teaching approach.
• Corporate networking and relationship-building skills.
• Research aptitude and academic leadership.
• Ability to bridge theory with real-world business applications.
What We Are Looking For A passionate educator who can not only teach finance concepts effectively but also transform students into industry-ready professionals through mentoring, career guidance, live projects, internships, and placement support. The candidate should be capable of bringing industry relevance into the classroom and contributing significantly to the overall development of MBA/PGDM students.
